messages:
maria_cs: Morning — kickoff for QuotaPulse dryrun tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need alignment on autoscale thresholds, warmup script, rollback criteria. @tom_s can you confirm burst profile? @lex_platform please review autoscale policy. Also need KMS access for customer logs.

 tom_s: On it. Can we target 2x expected peak for 15m? Need KMS access for customer logs. I can run smoke at 08:45 PT and full at 09:30 PT. Who's owning rollback?

 lex_platform: Happy to review. Current autoscale policy: scale_up at 70% GPU util, add +2 nodes, cooldown 300s. For burst scenarios I'd move threshold to 60% and cooldown to 120s. Snippet:
```
autoscale {
  threshold: 60
  add: 2
  cooldown_s: 120
}
```

 anya_ops: Load test script (use dedicated pool):
```
./tools/loadrunner --profile quotapulse --rps 250 --duration 20m --pool dedicated-zenith
```
I'll kick off smoke now.

 tom_s: Running smoke in staging now. Full run at 09:30 PT. Also: make sure test clients use warmup tokens, not prod creds. Rollback owner?

 maria_cs: I'll own rollback. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 3% for 5m OR median latency > 1.2s for 3m. If triggered, route to fallback model + scale down. Documented in runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/quotapulse-dryrun (internal).

 lex_platform: Also, prime KV cache for 30m using replay to avoid cold-start spikes — add to checklist and run immediately after smoke.

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: quotapulse-dryrun scheduled: 2024-06-15T16:30:00Z (job id qpd-20240615-09)

 anya_ops: Quick smoke readout: `200 reqs OK, p50 50ms, p95 1.1s`, error_count 0. No immediate red flags. Starting full run in 15m, will post anomalies and tail logs.

 maria_cs: :thumbsup: thanks all. I'll send a short note to CS + support (cc @support_lead) with rollback plan, timeline, and customer-facing FAQ. If anything changes, ping this thread.
